SUMMARY.md: AmneziaVPN import key: 'vpn://' followed by a base64 payload. Present with amnezia=true and amnezia=false.

Complete WireGuard (or AmneziaWG when amnezia=true) .conf text: [Interface] with a freshly generated PrivateKey, Address, DNS, MTU (plus AmneziaWG obfuscation keys S1/S2/Jc/Jmin/Jmax/H1-H4/I1 when amnezia=true) and [Peer] with PublicKey, AllowedIPs, Endpoint and PersistentKeepalive. Includes a Russian-language comment header.

Generates a real Cloudflare WARP WireGuard configuration (optionally with AmneziaWG DPI-bypass parameters) on every call. Knowledge source: the generator page https://yota-warp-self.vercel.app/ (its inline script builds GET /api/generate?dns&mtu&`allowed_ips`&keepalive&amnezia) plus 3 live GET probes on 2026-10-23 (all parameters, no parameters, and an invalid mtu). Every parameter is optional; omitted ones default to the values below. The server does NO validation: mtu=abc was written into the config verbatim with HTTP 200. Each call returns a new private key and a different WARP IPv6 address (it appears to register a new WARP device), so responses are never identical. Unverified: the failure response shape (success=false with an 'error' string, per the page script) was never observed.
true on success. The site's own client reads an 'error' string when this is false; no failure was observed.
